messages.subject: Project Falcon - Heads of Terms for sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Nadia,

Attached are the heads of terms reflecting what was agreed with Robert Pearce's team: supply price of £62.4m (£390k/MWh x 160 MWh), annual licence fee £840k, annual service charge £1.95m, 7-year LTSA, 97.5% guaranteed availability, and a liability cap of 125% of trailing Charges with a £15m supply super-cap. Exclusivity to 31 December. Subject to contract save for the binding paragraphs.

Happy to walk through before you send to Stratton.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

James
